scope_amendment: 2026-09-09 user confirmed product mainline; supersedes six independent branch coverage
scope: Product mainline: SFT -> DPO -> selection -> CISPO -> selection -> vision/video; Agent deferred, not a vision prerequisite
parallel_preparation_policy: User approved vision code and CPU data preparation alongside text training. Keep GPU vision training gated; low-priority, bounded-memory preprocessing, no duplicate extraction or silent data reduction.
reason: Vision starts only after verified text product selection, not after all algorithm branches.
weight_policy: SFT -> DPO -> evaluated selection of SFT/DPO -> CISPO -> evaluated selection -> vision/video; Agent is a separate extension
execution_policy: Keep the active pretrain/SFT run unchanged. Each new branch requires source/data/model verification and a local memory smoke test before its full official epoch budget.
deviation_policy: Record all hardware adaptations. Do not silently reduce model, epochs, data, generation length or group size and call it full alignment.

evaluation_scope.vision: pinned MiniMind-V eval_vlm.py six bundled images and description prompt
